clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, a well gives clear spring water for a shaman’s trial. The Filled Red Waterskin carries water drawn from the village well, amid ruins held by the Forsaken.

Brine, a hermit in the Barrens, sends shaman initiates to Tarren Mill for water training. The journey leads to the Hillsbrad Foothills, where decay and the dead surround the town. Yet the central well still draws clear spring water. Brine sees this pure water as a sign of endurance in an unhallowed land. She compares the uncorrupted spring with Warchief Thrall’s resolve through hardship. Gathering the water tests an initiate’s respect for its purity, even in hostile surroundings.
